patch_description: Key parameters in the current program: the SG smoothing bank (sg_half, h2), the slope blend weights (0.7 RTS / 0.3 gradient), the reversal-gate sigmoid thresholds (0.25/0.15 * q_scale), and the lead gain (0.125*sg_half). The weakest metric is smoothness (0.30) with elevated slope_changes (47.6) and false_reversals (34). Prior evidence shows noise reduction scales with smoothing-stage count (2 passes → 0.67, 3+ passes → smoothness 0.38, reversals 26-33). I therefore: (1) widen the second SG pass from sg_half//2 to (2*sg_half)//3 with a cubic kernel, (2) add a third short zero-phase pass (h3 = max(2, sg_half//3), quadratic) after lead compensation to suppress residual oscillation injected by the lead term, and (3) tighten the reversal-gate threshold from 0.25 to 0.30*q_scale so weak slopes get less lead amplification (fewer false reversals), while keeping lead gain moderate so lag_error stays ~0.33. All passes remain zero-phase, so phase delay is unaffected.
